summary: Denmark (DK) localization of Business Central 29. It covers OIOUBL electronic invoicing and NemHandel, electronic VAT declaration to SKAT, SAF-T and Regnskab Basis export, FIK payment matching, digital vouchers, Proløn payroll import and C5 data migration. Use it for questions about Danish bookkeeping and e-invoicing.
overview:
The Danish layer is almost entirely additive: 431 own objects and no changes to W1 objects. The largest parts are OIOUBL (checks, export codeunits, subscribers and table/page extensions on sales, reminder, finance charge memo and service documents), the electronic VAT declaration (codeunits "Elec. VAT Decl. ..." with interfaces for communication, payload builder and response), and a C5 data migration set (C5 codeunits, pages and tables).

Bank and finance support Danish payments and audit: FIK management and matching codeunits, payment export, SAF-T DK codeunits, standard account and tax code mapping, and the Regnskab Basis export. Digital voucher codeunits, Nemhandel status handling, and the Proløn payroll import XMLport complete the picture.

Learn documents the bookkeeping act, five-year retention, digital vouchers, OIOUBL setup, NemHandel, electronic VAT returns, SAF-T, Regnskab Basis, FIK details, VAT reconciliation, Intrastat and VIES reporting, and payroll data definitions.
key_points: OIOUBL: check and export codeunits for sales invoices, credit memos, reminders, finance charge memos and service documents, with GLN, account code and profile code on customers.
Electronic VAT declaration to the Danish Tax Agency via the VAT API, with certificates, Azure Key Vault and period retrieval.
SAF-T DK export and Regnskab Basis CSV export, using the standard chart of accounts mapping.
FIK payment handling: reconciliation matching of bank lines and journal lines, with transaction texts such as Matching Amount and Duplicate FIK Number.
Digital vouchers with attachment enforcement, mandatory by default from July 1, 2024, and five-year retention.
Nemhandel registration status and notification on Company Information; E-Document OIOUBL format and import.
Payroll import for Danish providers via data exchange definition and Proløn XMLport.
C5 data migration wizard objects for customers, vendors, items and ledger data.

areas.what: Adds a C5 data migration set: migrators for customers, vendors, items, ledger accounts and transactions, a schema reader, unzip, data loader, dashboard and install codeunit, plus C5 source-data pages and tables.

OIOUBL check and export codeunits for sales, reminder, finance charge and service documents, plus subscribers and common logic. Also Nemhandel status checking, the Digital Voucher DK implementation and an OIOUBL format codeunit.
areas.why: Learn describes OIOUBL as the format required by the Danish public sector, and digital vouchers as mandatory from July 1, 2024.

areas.what: Electronic VAT declaration codeunits and interfaces for SKAT submission, SAF-T DK export with standard accounts and tax codes, ECSL export file, Regnskab Basis export, and DK install and upgrade codeunits.
areas.why: Learn covers electronic VAT return submission through the Danish Tax Agency API, SAF-T export and the standard chart of accounts.

areas.what: FIK payment management, matching of bank reconciliation and general journal lines, payment export and fixed-width bank data export, with extensions on vendor, purchase, journal and payment pages.
areas.why: Learn explains the FIK transaction texts shown when payments are applied automatically to sales invoices.

areas.what: OIOUBL extensions on sales documents, posted documents, reminders, finance charge memos and customer, adding fields such as GLN, account code and profile code.
areas.why: Learn says customers need GLN, account code and profile code for OIOUBL documents.

areas.what: OIOUBL table and page extensions on service orders, invoices, credit memos, their posted and archive versions and service setup.
OIOUBL fields on payment terms, company information and country/region, with matching page extensions.
areas.why: Learn lists payment terms and company information among OIOUBL setup steps.

areas.what: E-Document integration for OIOUBL: an OIOUBL format enum extension, import into draft and a handler.
areas.why: Learn describes NemHandel e-invoicing through the E-Documents connector using OIOUBL or PEPPOL BIS 3.0.

areas.what: Import of Danish payroll transactions with a data exchange definition, Proløn XMLport, setup page and general journal extension.
areas.why: Learn says the extension maps payroll transaction types to G/L accounts for Danish payroll providers.

areas.what: Holds the C5 data loader status table used by the migration.
Adds an expense event subscriber for Denmark.
Extends item charge with OIOUBL fields.
areas.why: Learn lists item charges among OIOUBL setup items.

areas.what: Extends the record export buffer with OIOUBL data.

issues: Minor: 'SKAT' in the summary comes from the object name 'Elec. VAT Decl. SKAT API'. The Learn page calls the receiving body the Danish Tax Agency. The two are consistent, so this is acceptable.
Minor: the NemHandel Learn page also mentions PEPPOL BIS 3.0 and the E-Documents connector. The narrative leaves these out, which is a gap but not an error.
Minor: the five-year retention point comes from the separate retention page, which lists digital voucher preservation. Attaching it to the digital vouchers key point is supported.
